name: LucidView Universal - Floating Video & Enhancer
description: Ultimate universal video enhancer. Floating player with Ambient Glow, A-B loop & frame-step, filtered PiP, audio EQ (Bass/Voice/Night), volume boost, sleep timer, on-page HUD, per-site memory, wake lock, Lucid cinematic mode, Focus mode, timestamp marks with notes, playback resume, gestures (double-click seek / wheel volume), Media Session keys, frame gallery, and multi-video quality picker. Works on YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, X, Instagram, Twitch & any HTML5 video.
